description: This file declares the Client class used for IPC communication within the Rialto server manager component. It includes method declarations for connecting, setting state and configuration, pinging, and handling disconnections, as well as private methods for handling events. The class interacts with external components such as IChannel, IpcLoop, and session management interfaces.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: A class managing IPC client operations for the Rialto server manager, including connection, configuration, and event handling.

methods.name: Client
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Client with session manager, server ID, and socket.

methods.name: performSetConfiguration
methods.description: Configures the session server with initial state, socket name, display name, resource limits, and permissions.

methods.name: performPing
methods.description: Sends a ping with a specified ID.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets the logging levels for the client.
